name: Chino Spectrum Marketplace
demographics: Chino Spectrum Marketplace serves a diverse suburban family demographic in the Inland Empire, with primary visitors consisting of middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area attracts young families and professionals aged 25-54 seeking convenient shopping and dining options in a modern outdoor setting. The center draws from Chino, Chino Hills, and surrounding communities with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000 annually, appealing to value-conscious shoppers who appreciate quality retailers and diverse dining experiences in an accessible location.
description: Chino Spectrum Marketplace is a vibrant lifestyle shopping destination located at 4016 Grand Avenue in Chino, California, serving the growing Inland Empire community. This open-air shopping center offers visitors the ultimate shopping experience with a unique blend of specialty retailers and an extensive selection of dining options ranging from quick-service to full-service restaurants. The marketplace creates an inviting atmosphere where shoppers can immerse themselves in a modern retail environment that combines convenience with variety. Managed by Shin Yen Retail Property Management, the center has established itself as a go-to destination for both everyday shopping needs and leisurely dining experiences. With its strategic location and carefully curated tenant mix, Chino Spectrum Marketplace continues to serve as a community gathering place where residents can shop, dine, and connect in a welcoming outdoor setting.
summary: Chino Spectrum Marketplace is a modern lifestyle center in Chino offering a diverse mix of specialty retailers and dining experiences in an open-air format. The center provides convenient shopping and restaurant options for Inland Empire families and professionals seeking quality brands in an accessible location.
